R4_append_only_witness_substrate.interpretation: the agent cannot SET the append-only attribute (needs CAP_LINUX_IMMUTABLE), so a root-provisioned append-only witness would resist agent rewrite. No such witness is deployed. The rewrite result above concerns only a probe-created file.
